messages:
maya: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for svc-auth (root cause: token cache TTL race + canary rollout gap). I want to lock owners & deadlines for remediation and add two tiny runbook steps for triage + rollback. Proposing EOW for infra fixes, next Tue for code change. Thoughts?

alex: I can take the token-cache fix (ensure TTL update is atomic + add metrics). Target: Tue EOD. Will open a PR today.

sam: I'll own the playbook edits — add explicit canary rollback commands and a checklist for verifying cache warmup. Will PR a markdown patch by tomorrow.

liam: I'll add the alert/query and dashboards (slow auth-rate + cache-miss spike). ETA: Thur. Query I'll add to runbook: 
```
# quick prometheus for auth cache miss rate
sum(rate(auth_cache_misses_total[5m])) by (instance)
```

linh: I'll coordinate recurring incident pattern tracking and schedule a monthly 30m review of incidents tagged "auth-cache". Also will add a blameless-owners rotation note.

incident-bot: created task INC-FOLLOWUP-1873 (https://tracker.internal/INC-FOLLOWUP-1873) assigned to [alex,sam,liam,linh] due 2026-06-12.

alex: quick note — for the code fix I plan to add a small migration that sets a conservative TTL and a test harness to reproduce the race locally. Will include rollout notes.

maya: @alex, @sam please make runbook lines explicit and copy the rollback snippet below into the triage section. Keep it minimal so oncall can act fast.

maya: Rollback snippet to add: 
```
# rollback canary deployment for svc-auth
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/svc-auth --to-revision=$(kubectl -n prod rollout history deploy/svc-auth | tail -n +2 | awk '/REVISION/ {print $1; exit}')
# verify pods back to previous revision
kubectl -n prod get pods -l app=svc-auth -o wide
```

sam: added checklist item: "confirm cache warmup for >95% traffic on canary before scaling" and a short command to prime cache. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/402

liam: uploaded dashboard tiles and created alert rule: auth_cache_miss_rate > 0.05 for 5m => paging. Added runbook section with run query and quick remediation steps.

linh: calendar invite created for recurring incident-pattern sync: first meeting 2026-06-18 09:00 PT. Will post notes after first session.

maya: Summary: owners set — alex (code fix) due 2026-06-09, sam (playbook edits + rollback) due 2026-06-05, liam (alerts/dashboards) due 2026-06-11, linh (recurring sync) initial meeting 2026-06-18. INC-FOLLOWUP-1873 tracks progress. Please update that ticket when PRs land. :thumbsup:

alex: ack.

sam: ack, will merge when CI passes.

liam: ack.

linh: ack — I'll add notes to the incident digest after first sync.

maya: thanks all — closing the thread, will follow up in the ticket if anything slips.
